import re, collections
pair_data=[]
for txt in usermsgs:
    for m in re.finditer(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \1 output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance|\Z)', txt, re.S):
        num,h,w,ins,oh,ow,outs=m.groups()
        def parse_grid(s, hh, ww):
            rows=[[int(v) for v in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
            assert len(rows)==int(hh) and all(len(row)==int(ww) for row in rows), (num,len(rows),[len(row) for row in rows],hh,ww)
            return rows
        pair_data.append((int(num),parse_grid(ins,h,w),parse_grid(outs,oh,ow)))
print(len(pair_data), [(n,len(a),len(a[0]),len(b),len(b[0])) for n,a,b in pair_data])
